ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Nostalgia.cs:11-14) == cost 1 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars, no animation trigger.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<NostalgiaPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Nostalgia.cs:18) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, NostalgiaPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. NostalgiaPower is the ported `modify_card_play_result_pile` implementer the sim's play pipeline consults (combat.py:505-509), which is what makes card/havoc's direct exhaust-pile append a recorded (dormant) divergence.
